title: CA<->leg bilateral restricted revision-differential transfer onto the leg pairs GBPUSD/AUDUSD/NZDUSD (vintaged first-print revision gaps, CA-anchored obs-month join, per-leg PIT-gated max-v2 availability entry, daily 16:00-NY grid)

blindness_declaration.statement: Written with ZERO outcome exposure: no scored/PnL/smoke/novelty numbers for this cycle were read; no backtest executed. Only timing, availability, coverage and count evidence from the pinned ng3 P0 restricted revision census (sha256 0fc108631e6b4bb2111c3528b873e68505ab2b46247d5e39cba24a12ff35017f, re-measured at this checkout), the P0 pin re-verification gate and the family-failure inventory was consumed; the census magnitude blocks are descriptive-only by their own law and were not used to set, move or justify any threshold or direction decision.

mechanism.story: Each CA-anchored differential month pairs Canada's restricted CPI revision with the contemporaneous restricted revision of at least one non-anchor leg (GB/AU/NZ/US). The bilateral differential D_L = R_CA - R_L reprices CAD relative to leg L's currency. Slow G10 participants - monthly dealing-cycle benchmark rebalancers and calendar-fixing corporate hedgers - do not hold CAD-cross books; they hold USD pairs and implement relative-inflation views as baskets. Long-CAD-versus-L decomposes on that instrument set into SHORT USDCAD plus LONG L-vs-USD. Proposal P1 trades the first decomposition leg on the anchor pair; THIS proposal trades the second: the CA-anchored differential TRANSFERRED onto the leg's own pair, in exactly the months where that leg carries a restricted event (so its revision is readable and the differential is bilateral). The leg-side implementation is the slow one: it happens at scheduled dealing windows, after both v2 vintages are evidenced-available - inside the horizon this lane can provably observe.
mechanism.forced_or_late_participant: Forced/late participants: (i) monthly dealing-cycle real-money accounts implement bloc relative-inflation updates only after the month's revision evidence completes and only at scheduled windows - structurally late relative to the v2 availability sequence; (ii) THIS LANE ITSELF is a declared late participant: entry requires the evidenced vintaged availability of BOTH sides of the bilateral differential - CA's v2 AND leg L's v2 - and the pinned census shows v2 vintage days arriving weeks-to-months after the obs month (census samples: CA obs 2017-11 v2 2018-10-09; AU/NZ quarter-vintaged feeds arrive on the ~quarterly vintage calendar). The hypothesis is specifically that the differential-keyed leg-pair repricing SURVIVES the PIT-provable max-v2 availability lag plus the 5-grid-day holding horizon, after costs.
mechanism.why_differential_not_absolute: On the LEG's own pair (e.g. GBPUSD), the leg-side inflation path is the first-order pricing term: the relevant state is how CA's revision moved RELATIVE TO the leg's own revision, not CA's revision alone. The bilateral differential nets the leg's revision out of the CA signal: a GB revision of the same sign and size as CA's cancels the relative move (D_GB = 0, no position); a GB revision of opposite sign doubles it. The absolute-CA form cannot distinguish these months - it fires both identically - which is exactly the V7 re-clock surface, and why the no-differential control is lane-mandatory. The differential is also the honest use of the restricted streams' asymmetry: CA's stream is the genuinely-alive anchor (72 events; plan section 3), while GB/AU/NZ/US revisions are measured only to DIFFERENCE OUT the common component - no leg ever anchors an event.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: It must fail (after-cost per-trade expectancy <= 0) if the leg pairs' late windows after joint v2 availability carry no differential-signed drift. It must die by falsification if the SAME cross-pair book fired on the ABSOLUTE CA revision sign without any leg revision (the mandatory CTL-V7NODIFF - V7 cross-economy reaction-direction re-clocked onto the revision clock) reproduces the anchor; if a nominal-yield-level exposure reproduces it (V8 law; ng1-A4-P2 cluster #15 proved the DGS10-level shadow the most lethal control in this program); if a constant-direction calendar shadow reproduces it (Q-7); if a sign-permuted leg book reproduces it (order-preserving placebo); if the quote-differential source parameterization out-earns the bilateral form (neighbour, V8 R2 standard); or at D2 if pooled ancestry |rho| > 0.20 vs the full inventory including both V7 cross-pair books and the FXNG1-A5-P1 anchor (accepted in advance).

information_source_and_surprise_construc.information_source: REALIZED vintaged CPI revision gaps from the pinned ng3 restricted (first-print) revision census only - no announcement-calendar, no publication-order, no consensus/forecast data anywhere (this lane reads NO release-order state: that ancestor is dead, see ancestry_defense). Per economy X and obs month m: v1 = first vintage publishing m, v2 = immediately following vintage (strict monotonicity, fail-closed), R_X(m) = 100 * ( I_v2(m) / I_v1(m) - 1 ) in percentage points (ng2 section 4 frozen semantics, inherited via the census import).

differential_construction.stream: RESTRICTED stream only, both sides of every differential: first_print_in_realtime_era=True AND no bulk re-referencing group membership (>= 10 events sharing an identical (v1 day, v2 day, ratio-to-1e-6) signature excluded by census law)
differential_construction.join_law: CA-anchored obs-month join, verbatim from the census: an obs month m (quarter-first-month keys for AU/NZ, V9 law) counts iff CA carries a restricted event AND >= 1 other economy (GB/AU/NZ/US non-anchor legs) carries a restricted event in the same obs month; months with non-anchor overlap but NO CA event are disclosed (15 measured, incl. the 2023-12..2024-12 US-only run) and NEVER counted; they are unreachable by every arm of this proposal (fail-closed, no patch)
differential_construction.event_unit: a TRANSFER EVENT is a pair (m, L) with L in {GB, AU, NZ}: leg L carries a restricted event in differential month m. USDCAD NEVER fires in this proposal (that is A5-P1's construction, distinct by design); the US revision is never a transfer destination (quote leg of every funded pair, never anchored by law)
differential_construction.bilateral_form: D_L(m) = R_CA(m) - R_L(m) for each transfer event (m, L)

universe.event_instrument_law: each transfer event (m, L) fires exactly ONE pair-decision, on leg L's OWN pair (GB->GBPUSD, AU->AUDUSD, NZ->NZDUSD); the CA and US revisions are SIGNAL INPUTS ONLY (vintaged channel, V9 HIGH finding binding - current-vintage revised-in-place tables FORBIDDEN for every non-US leg and for CA); no leg economy anchors any event (anchoring = whose stream defines the event state: that is CA alone).
universe.direction_law: D_L(m) >= +0.02 pp => CAD's inflation path revised up relative to leg L => the bloc expression of long-CAD-vs-L fires its leg-pair component => LONG the leg currency vs USD (long GBPUSD / AUDUSD / NZDUSD). D_L(m) <= -0.02 pp => the mirror (SHORT the leg currency vs USD). |D_L(m)| < 0.02 pp => no position on that leg pair. Two-sided by construction: no static currency or dollar bias.

ancestry_defense.v7_reaction_direction_closed_SPECIFIC: FOREX-FREE-V7 closed the reaction-direction class 'on both sides of the economy boundary', and this TRANSFER form is the closest living relative of that closure's cross-economy side: FXFV7-A4-P1 (cross-economy release-sign spillover onto non-reporting pairs) died mechanically AND by falsification-by-control cluster #12; FXFV7-A6-P2 (cross-pair lead-lag diffusion) died with its own-lag control OUT-earning it - the specific reason this proposal's control battery keeps the transfer form itself under the no-differential control rather than trusting the rho gate alone. DECLARED KILL CANDIDATE. This lane differs STRUCTURALLY on four axes: (i) the transferred object is a DIFFERENTIAL-OF-REVISIONS (v1->v2 vintage gaps between two economies), not a release sign at publication - an object that does not exist in any V6/V7 construction; (ii) the transfer is BILATERAL - the destination leg's own revision is read and netted out (a same-signed leg revision cancels the position; the V7 spillover form has no such term); (iii) entry is strictly after the max-v2 PIT-provable availability of BOTH sides - V7 entered at publication instants; (iv) LOAD-BEARING: every fill is selected by the CA-anchored restricted join, a vintage-gap state that does not exist in any V6/V7/ng1 construction. The distinction is ALSO carried as a mandatory measurement: CTL-V7NODIFF runs the absolute-CA cross-pair transfer on the identical fired book (kill at >= 0.5x same-sign per-trade, accepted in advance), and D2 pooled |rho| <= 0.20 applies vs the full inventory including both V7 books; over the bar => lane dies at D2.
ancestry_defense.fxng1_a5_p1_release_order_closed_SPECIFI: FOREX-NG1 A5-P1 (opening-follower release-order own-pair rollout) is measured-dead (anchor -9.806836/trade net tier 2.0, PF 0.827161; R1/R3/R4/R5 FAIL; notably R2 PASSED - it was NOT a V7 re-clock; 'release-order frontier measured-dead on this grid'). DECLARED KILL CANDIDATE. This proposal reads NO publication order, no announcement calendar, no first-release instants and no release sequence state anywhere: its state is the census obs-month JOIN of restricted revision events, its values are v1->v2 gaps, and its clock is v2 vintaged availability. The axes are disjoint (order-of-release vs differential-of-revision); nevertheless the D2 pooled |rho| <= 0.20 gate applies vs the FXNG1-A5-P1 anchor book, and the shared grid/hold plus overlapping pair set (GBPUSD/AUDUSD/NZDUSD were ng1-A5 destinations' pairs) makes that rho measurement genuinely binding rather than nominal - accepted in advance.
ancestry_defense.v8_nominal_level_law: V8 falsification-by-control #14 made a nominal-exposure control MANDATORY on every yield/inflation lane, and FOREX-NG1 A4-P2 (cluster #15) was killed by exactly this control (CTL-DGS10LEVEL +4.13/trade out-earned a -6.63/trade anchor) - the DGS10-level shadow is the most lethal control in the forex program. Carried as CTL-DGS10LEVEL on the identical per-leg clock; no nominal yield level enters the signal. If the control reproduces the anchor, the family is dead by law.
ancestry_defense.v9_ppp_vetoes: V9 A5-P1/P2 died as PPP/real-rate LEVEL-misalignment books (rho 0.3034/0.3119 vs the V8 anchor). This proposal carries no PPP, real-rate, or level-misalignment state anywhere: the differential is a CHANGE-gap between two revision ratios, not a level; conditioning is event-time join structure, two-sided, magnitude-gated. D2 rho gate vs the V9 veto books applies.

frozen_rule_order: R1 MECHANICAL: anchor after-cost per-trade expectancy at stress tier 2.0 <= 0 => family dead (plain negative); remaining rules moot

R2 NO_DIFFERENTIAL_V7_REClock (MANDATORY, lane-specific): CTL-V7NODIFF same-sign per-trade expectancy >= 0.5x anchor => the bilateral differential carries nothing; the book is the FXFV7-A4-P1 absolute-revision cross-economy spillover class re-clocked onto the max-v2 availability clock => dead + D2 VETO recorded (this is the plan section 5 lane-A5 closure test)
R3 NOMINAL_EXPOSURE (V8 law): CTL-DGS10LEVEL same-sign expectancy >= 0.5x anchor => dead (nominal-yield-level exposure in new words; cluster #14/#15 law)
R4 CLOCK_ONLY (Q-7): SHADOW-CLOCK same-sign expectancy >= 0.5x anchor => dead (per-leg max-v2 calendar drift on the leg basket explains it)
R5 PLACEBO: PLACEBO-DIFFPERM same-sign expectancy >= 0.5x anchor => dead (the book, its calendar/pair structure and its sign marginals explain it; the differential-sign alignment carries nothing)

R6 NEIGHBOUR_SOURCE_PARAMETERIZATION: NEIGH-QUOTESRC expectancy > anchor expectancy => the bilateral (leg-netting) differential is not mechanism-bearing (the quote-differential form is, or neither is) => dead (V8 R2 standard on the differential source)
falsification_rule.external_gate: D2 ancestry pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs full inventory (incl. both V7 cross-pair books, the V8 nominal-level shadow, the V9 vetoes AND the FXNG1-A5-P1 release-order anchor book), margin recorded (P-2); over the bar => D2 VETO
falsification_rule.no_threshold_moves: no rule, threshold, horizon, or the placebo RNG seed changes after any scored number is seen (P-15); smoke numbers kill + disclose, never select

expected_failure_interpretation.R1_with_clean_controls: the leg pairs' post-joint-availability windows carry no differential-signed drift after costs: the CA-anchored bilateral revision transfer does not survive to the PIT-provable max-v2 horizon. CONSISTENT WITH (not contradicting) the V7 and FXNG1-A5-P1 closures - those closed publication-instant spillover and release-order; a null here licenses NO claim about either horizon.
expected_failure_interpretation.R2_fires: the anchor is the V7 cross-economy spillover book wearing a differential mask; the lane-level closure re-fires exactly as the plan mandated. The most likely failure mode of this family and the reason the no-differential control is lane-mandatory.
expected_failure_interpretation.R3_fires: the transfer book is a nominal-yield-level exposure in new words; the V8 law re-fires on the revision lane exactly as it did on ng1-A4-P2 (cluster #15).
expected_failure_interpretation.R4_fires: per-leg calendar-frequency drift on transfer-event days, not relative-revision information.
expected_failure_interpretation.R5_fires: the fired-count, calendar and pair structure plus the sign marginals alone explain it; which events carried which differential sign carries nothing.
expected_failure_interpretation.R6_fires: the bilateral source is not mechanism-bearing (the quote-differential form is, or neither is); the family still dies (no rescue by re-ranking arms).
